use_case: A Brazilian data engineer asks the agent in Portuguese to properly fix a nightly payments reconciliation Airflow DAG. The real cause only appears in English prod logs and an English infra maintenance config.
situation: The prod reconcile_ledger DAG reads from a hot-standby replica at 03:10 UTC. A VACUUM runs on the primary at the same time, and the replica cancels the query with a recovery conflict. A Portuguese runbook and a staging log both point the agent toward partner API timeouts and more retries instead.
must_keep: The prod log showing QueryCanceled due to conflict with recovery on pg-replica-2 at 03:14 UTC. Also the maintenance.yaml showing the 03:00–03:40 UTC primary VACUUM on ledger_entries, along with the replica's 30s max_standby_streaming_delay and hot_standby_feedback off.
may_drop: The directory listing, the DAG source, the Portuguese runbook (stale advice to raise retries and the API timeout), the staging ReadTimeout log, the hedged assistant guess, and the filler test, git and code output.
why_judges_fail: The goal is in Portuguese and shares words like reconciliação, madrugada and retry with the Portuguese runbook, but shares almost none with the English Postgres log and YAML. A lexical or language-biased compactor keeps the runbook and drops the real evidence, so the agent ends up adding retries or raising the API timeout.
goal: Bom dia! O job de reconciliação quebrou de novo essa madrugada. Consegue corrigir de vez? Não quero só aumentar retry de novo.

blocks.text: Oi, esse é o repo do pipeline de pagamentos (payflow-etl). Dá uma olhada no DAG de reconciliação, ele vive falhando de madrugada e o pessoal do financeiro reclama toda manhã.
